blurb: Bristol Mountain offers skiing and snowboarding on 39 slopes and trails with a 1,200' vertical and 2 high-speed quads. The resort provides night skiing with lighting on 97% of trails during the night season. They host events such as the Blue Suspenders Expedition and Climb to the Summit Series.
